verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-ATS collaboration features: no @mentions, shared notes, tasks, or visibility rules that scope sensitive feedback. The rating-creation and permission_sets API endpoints are developer building blocks or adjacent controls, not this collaboration capability. Team collaboration is a fair axis for an ATS, so the verdict is none rather than na.
